name: Google (Programmable Search)

rate_limit.source: No published limit for the hosted search page; kept to a person's pace.

license_note: Google results through the person's own Programmable Search Engine (its public page, rendered in the person's browser). Needs the engine's ID (`cx`, OCTOS_GOOGLE_CSE_CX), created at programmablesearchengine.google.com and set to search the entire web. Titles, snippets and links only.
